name: ALINA TWIN TOWERS & SUITES
paras: Accommodation: Alina Twin Towers & Suites offers a refined blend of hotel-style luxury and spacious residential living, with a total of 63 elegantly designed units across its iconic twin towers.

The Hotel Tower features 45 well-appointed rooms, including 36 expansive hotel rooms with a separate living area—ideal for extended stays or guests seeking additional comfort—and 9 stylish rooms without a living room, perfect for short stays and business travelers.

Complementing the hotel offering, the property includes 18 fully serviced apartments designed for families and long-term guests. These consist of 9 two-bedroom apartments and 9 three-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully laid out to provide a home-like experience with generous living spaces, dining areas, and modern conveniences.

All accommodations are tastefully furnished with premium bedding, contemporary interiors, and functional workspaces. Guests can expect amenities such as high-speed WiFi, smart TVs, air conditioning, in-room safes, and fully equipped kitchens in the apartments, ensuring both comfort and convenience for every type of stay.

Location: Alina Twin Towers & Suites is centrally located in Arusha , providing convenient access to key business districts, shopping areas, and major transport links. Positioned as a gateway to Tanzania’s renowned northern safari circuit, the property offers an ideal base for both business and leisure travelers, with easy connections to destinations such as Serengeti National Park and Ngorongoro Crater .

Facilities & Services: The public areas of Alina Twin Towers & Suites feature a sophisticated collection of spaces including a stylish lounge, restaurant, and bar, designed to offer both comfort and a contemporary urban atmosphere. The property caters to both business and leisure guests with a range of modern facilities.

Additional facilities include a swimming pool, fully equipped gym, spa and wellness area, conference and meeting rooms, and a business center. The property also offers laundry services, 24-hour reception, concierge services, and secure parking.

Designed with comfort and accessibility in mind, the majority of the property is wheelchair-friendly. The hotel also incorporates efficient energy solutions and modern infrastructure to ensure a sustainable and seamless guest experience.

name: MOUNT MERU HOTEL
paras: Location: Set within 15 acres of beautiful landscaping at the foot of Mount Meru (4572 metres) less than two kilometres from Arusha city centre, 50 minutes drive from Kilimanjaro International Airport and 10 minutes from Arusha airport, Mount Meru Hotel is ideally situated for business and holiday visitors. Mount Meru Hotel is an old address in Arusha and is reopening towards the end of 2010 after a major renovation.

Accommodation: The hotel has a selection of 178 rooms, all with en suite bathrooms, air conditioning, direct dial telephone, WiFi, satellite television, electronic safe, mini bar, tea & coffee making facilities.
Facilities & Services: Facilities include three restaurants, two bars, conference hall seating up to 400 people with breakaway rooms, gift shop, and a swimming pool.

name: KIBO PALACE HOTEL
paras: Location: Situated less than a kilometre from Arusha city centre and about 45 minutes drive from Kilimanjaro International Airport, Kibo Palace is an ideal base for both business travelers and visitors on holiday.

Accommodation: Kibo Palace boasts 77 beautifully appointed rooms and suites, all with bathrooms en suite, wireless internet connection (WIFI), direct dialing telephone service, writing desk, satellite television, electronic deposit safe, tea & coffee making facilities, hair dryers, and air conditioning.

Facilities & Services: Other facilities include the main restaurant, two bars, room service, a swimming pool, fitness centre, curio / gift shop, business centre, five fully air conditioned conference rooms accommodating up to 100 people, offering a variety of sizes and configurations tailored to meet your needs.

name: SIRINGIT VILLA BY MANTIS
paras: Location: Siringit Villa is situated in the private and secure Kilimanjaro Golf & Wildlife Estate, located near the small town of Usa River, about 40 minutes-drive from both the city of Arusha and the Kilimanjaro International Airport. Access to the estate is by a 6-kilometre road which leads off the highway running from Arusha to Moshi.

Accommodation: Siringit Villa features six exclusive and luxurious bedrooms, four of which are inter-leading, and three of which can be used as triples. The spacious and elegant property can be booked for exclusive use or as individual rooms, and is meant to give friends or families a unique African experience. Suite facilities include terrace or balcony, full en-suite bathroom, solar heated water (24/7), hairdryer, and in-room safe. All rooms are non-smoking.

Facilities & Services: The gorgeous living room, the fine dining area, the outside dining terrace, the lush gardens and the solar heated invigorating infinity pool have been designed to meet the requirements of the most discerning of visitors. The daily menu will be tailored to your desire, offering a wholesome gastronomic experience with emphasis on seasonality and fresh local produce.

Other Villa features include fireplaces (in most areas), breakfast bar, BBQ area, and Spa treatments. Also available are complimentary WiFi, reading books, board games, laundry & housekeeping service, room service, and child-minding services (surcharge).

Activities include Cycling, Nduruma Polo & Country Club, Helicopter Flights (by Gilroy & Camm) Horse Riding (by Gilroy & Camm) Polo Lessons (by Gilroy & Camm) Golf on Kili Golf Estate (by Gilroy & Camm) Golf Lessons (by Gilroy & Camm) Cultural Tours (by Gilroy & Camm). Reservations required for golf, spa treatments and all off-site activities. Visa, Master Card and AMEX accepted.

name: PLANET LODGE
paras: Location: Situated on 4 ½ acres of lush gardens, in Moshono village about 7 kilometres from Arusha city centre, this African village styled accommodation places you in the centre of a delicate balance where nature and casual living intersect.

Accommodation: Planet Lodge offers the rustic appeal of a native African village, featuring 14 chalets with each chalet housing 2 guest rooms. The chalets are tastefully decorated with native African décor, and each room has en suite bathroom with shower, hot & cold running water, beautiful artisan beds with mosquito netting, air conditioning, desk & chair, telephone, alarm clock, free Wi-Fi, and a private balcony for scenic views.

Facilities & Services: The lodge has a restaurant on site serving international and local dishes, and a full service bar with friendly lounge area to relax and unwind. Other facilities include a swimming pool set on a beautiful garden with views of Mount Meru.

name: ARUMERU RIVER LODGE
paras: Location: Spread over 12 acres of beautifully landscaped gardens and natural African bush land on an old coffee farm, less than a kilometre off the Arusha- Moshi road, 20 km from Arusha town and 35 km from Kilimanjaro international Airport, Arumeru Lodge is an ideal facility for visitors on holiday and business alike.
Accommodation: Arumeru River Lodge offers 21 standard rooms, 6 junior suites, and 1 large suite with two bedrooms, all with bathrooms en suite and verandahs.

Facilities & Services: Other facilities include two restaurants - the main carvery and the terrace, a bar, a solar-heated swimming pool, internet facilities, a boutique / curio shop, jogging parcours trail.

name: KIA LODGE
paras: Location: Situated on a low hill on the foot of Mount Kilimanjaro, less than three (3) minutes drive from Kilimanjaro International Airport (KIA), and centrally located between Moshi and Arusha towns for Kilimanjaro climbing and safari tours, KIA Lodge is an ideal stopover after a long flight or for visitors departing on early morning flight.
Accommodation: The lodge offers 40 en suite rooms housed in twenty cottages, all with air conditioning, mosquito net, telephone, and safe deposit box

Facilities & Services: Other facilities include a restaurant, bar, wireless internet in public areas, curio shop, a hilltop swimming pool with 360º view of Mt Kilimanjaro, Mt Meru and the Maasai plains around.

name: FOUR POINT BY SHERATON HOTEL
paras: Accommodation: Alina Twin Towers & Suites offers a refined blend of hotel-style luxury and spacious residential living, with a total of 63 elegantly designed units across its iconic twin towers.

The Hotel Tower features 45 well-appointed rooms, including 36 expansive hotel rooms with a separate living area—ideal for extended stays or guests seeking additional comfort—and 9 stylish rooms without a living room, perfect for short stays and business travelers.

Complementing the hotel offering, the property includes 18 fully serviced apartments designed for families and long-term guests. All accommodations are tastefully furnished with premium bedding, contemporary interiors, and functional workspaces. Guests can expect amenities such as high-speed WiFi, smart TVs, air conditioning, in-room safes, and fully equipped kitchens in the apartments, ensuring both comfort and convenience for every type of stay.

Location: Alina Twin Towers & Suites is centrally located in Arusha , providing convenient access to key business districts, shopping areas, and major transport links.
